subject: disclosure: one check_models run used the ambient hosted DATABASE_URL (read attempt, closed by the pooler); scrubbed env since
body: integ-green-3: my first run of tools/check_models.py was in a shell that still had the ambient hosted DATABASE_URL/SUPABASE_* values, so it tried to open one psycopg connection to the hosted pooler to read app_config (a SELECT; the server closed the connection, nothing was written). I have not run anything else with those values. Every command since goes through a scrubbed env (hosted vars unset, loopback DB 54322, storage 54335, throwaway auth stack). The unit pytest run before that also inherited the ambient env (marked not live/not db; no hosted connection was seen in its output) and I am re-running it scrubbed. Not a secret leak: no values were printed or logged.
